## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `hubspot-crm-obj-companies-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a HubSpot developer app

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your [HubSpot Developer account](https://developers.hubspot.com/). -->
2. Select **Apps** in the top navigation.
3. Select **Create app**.
4. <!-- manual: Enter an App name and optional description. -->
5. Select **Create app**.

## Step 3: Configure OAuth scopes

1. <!-- manual: Inside your new app, open the Auth tab. -->
2. <!-- manual: Under Scopes, add the following required scopes: -->
3. <!-- manual: crm.objects.companies.read -->
4. <!-- manual: crm.objects.companies.write -->
5. <!-- manual: Add a Redirect URL for the OAuth callback (e.g., https://localhost:9090). -->
6. Select **Save**.

## Step 4: Install the app and authorize

1. <!-- manual: In the Auth tab, copy your Client ID and note your configured Redirect URL. -->
2. <!-- manual: Construct the install URL using your client ID, redirect URI, and required scopes: -->
3. <!-- manual: Open the URL in a browser and select the HubSpot portal to install the app into. -->
4. Select **Connect app** to authorize.
5. After authorization, HubSpot redirects to your redirect URI with a `code` query parameter. Copy this authorization code.

## Step 5: Exchange the authorization code for tokens

1. <!-- manual: Copy the refresh_token: this is required to authenticate the Ballerina connector. -->

## Step 6: Retrieve your client ID and client secret

1. <!-- manual: In your app's Auth tab, copy the Client ID. -->
2. Select **Show** next to **Client secret** and copy the value.
